verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or account-portability feature. There is no bulk export, no open-format download, and no offboarding or data-takeout path. The REST API and MCP tools that return JSON (e.g. listOfContracts) are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
